_meta.description: Single source of truth for all strategy, backtest, and optimizer parameters. Edit this file only. Never hardcode values in scripts. v3.10: trail_stop_mult 5.5→3.5 (trail sweep), sma_slow 200→250 (WFO full_v1), formula field added. v3.11: fast grid recentred on fast_v3 (2026-03-27). Validation status: 9/10 tests, 18/30 MARGINAL, Tier 3 PAPER TRADE. T09 (drawdown duration) is the only failing test — structural 2022-2023 artefact.

indicators._comment: Technical indicator periods. sma_fast/sma_slow drive compute_indicators() in Script 16/17. atr_period drives stop-loss sizing in Scripts 8/16. adx_period is fixed at 14 (Wilder standard). sma_slow updated 200 → 250 per WFO full_v1 recommendation (2026-03-27).

trend_qualification._comment: Three-condition trend filter (Script 6). All three must be TRUE simultaneously. adx_threshold = entry gate. adx_weak = exit trigger (must be < adx_threshold). adx_weakness_days = consecutive days below adx_weak before exit.

momentum._comment: Momentum scoring formula (Scripts 7/16). formula='sma_dist': Score = ((Close - SMA_slow) / SMA_slow) * 100. sma_period must always match indicators.sma_slow. ROC periods are supplementary (stored for supplementary output, not used for ranking).

stops._comment: ATR-based stop-loss system (Scripts 8/16). init_stop_mult: set once at entry, never lowered. trail_stop_mult: activates after trail_activation profit. Trailing updates Fridays only, ratchets up only. trail_stop_mult reduced from 5.5 → 3.5 (2026-03-27 trail sweep: 3.5 passes T03 max_dd=-26.0% while maintaining Sharpe 0.670, superior to 3.0 and 2.5).

position_sizing._comment: Inverse-ATR volatility-scaled sizing (Scripts 9/16). risk_per_trade = fraction of equity at risk per position. Floor/ceiling clip prevents outsized or negligible positions.

portfolio_constraints._comment: Hard and soft allocation limits (Scripts 9/11/14). max_crypto_pct is a hard cap. Sector and concentration limits are warnings that halt new entries. correlation_lookback_days is used for pairwise correlation check.

execution._comment: Transaction cost model (Script 16). cost_bps = round-trip basis points (10 bps = 0.10% per side). Slippage applied at fill simulation.

circuit_breakers._comment: Automated halt conditions (Scripts 11/14/16). cb_drawdown_halt triggers full entry suspension with cb_min_halt_days minimum pause. cb_drawdown_warn and cb_drawdown_watch are monitoring thresholds only. VIX resume requires cb_vix_resume_days consecutive days below cb_vix_resume.

backtesting._comment: Backtest engine defaults (Script 16). initial_equity is the default starting capital; always overridable via CLI. risk_free_rate used for Sharpe/Sortino. benchmark_symbol used for relative performance comparison.

walk_forward._comment: WFO window geometry (Script 17). is_months = in-sample optimization window. oos_months = out-of-sample validation window (12m prevents single-regime dominance). roll_months = step size between windows.

optimization_grid._comment: Full WFO parameter search space (Script 17). trail_stop_mult grid updated: upper bound kept at 5.5 for WFO exploration, but 3.5 is now the confirmed deployment value (2026-03-27). sma_slow extended to 350 (WFO full_v1 mean=250). max_positions mean=40 across all runs.

optimization_grid_fast._comment: Reduced grid for quick iteration / quarterly re-checks (Script 17 --fast-mode). Centred on fast_v3 (2026-03-27) confirmed values: sma_slow mean=264 (→250/300), trail_stop_mult mean=3.55 (→3.5 deployment), max_positions mean=40.

fixed_params._comment: Parameters excluded from WFO grid. sma_fast CV=0.374 (too unstable to optimise). adx_threshold=25 (FIX-6 ADX rising filter; false entries below 25 confirmed by 2022 attribution). init_stop_mult CV=0.000 across all WFO runs — universally stable. trail_activation, risk_per_trade, cost_bps are strategy-design constants. trail_stop_mult=3.5 is the confirmed deployment value (2026-03-27 trail sweep + fast_v3 WFO).

monte_carlo._comment: Simulation parameters (Script 18). All three methods must pass gates before live deployment.

validation_status._comment: Latest validation chain results. Updated after each full run.
